feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 August 2026 11:22am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 13 August 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly South or Southwest 2 or 3 today, but Variable in places, then generally Variable or West 2 or 3 tonight. Veering and increasing North or Northwest 4 or 5 in the northwest of the area later tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then risk of mist and fog patches from later today onwards, most likely in south of area and then in the east.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Becoming North or Northwest 4 or 5 in all waters tomorrow afternoon, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Still a risk of mist and fog patches at first in east of area, but soon becoming generally fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, but poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches at first.
